relations.text: Penumbraの全株を取得する最終契約を発表(2026年1月)
relations.text_en: Agreed to acquire all of Penumbra (January 2026)

source.label: Boston Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 15, 2026, we announced our entry into a definitive agreement to acquire 100 percent of Penumbra, Inc.

relations.text: 傘下のRMCがPenumbra製品を再販していた(2024年に終了)
relations.text_en: Its RMC unit resold Penumbra catheters until 2024

source.label: OSR Holdings 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: RMC's distribution agreement with Penumbra Inc. for the resale of its reperfusion catheter, neuron delivery catheter and related tubing and canister, expired on June 30, 2024.

relations.text: 最も注目すべき競合の一社
relations.text_en: One of its most notable competitors

source.label: Penumbra 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our most notable competitors are Boston Scientific, Medtronic, Stryker (now including Inari Medical), Terumo and several private companies.
